items.title: Instagram brings Edits to desktop to take on CapCut
items.summary: The move puts Edits in more direct competition with ByteDance's CapCut, the video-editing app Meta sought to challenge when it launched Edits last year.
items.creator: Aisha Malik

items.title: ElevenLabs now lets users publish AI-generated music directly on SoundCloud
items.summary: ElevenLabs said more than 25 million tracks have been generated using its music models.
items.creator: Ivan Mehta

items.title: Aina’s smart ring has a screen, a joystick and a mic so you can talk to AI agents
items.summary: Aina's ring can also take calls and help you dictate notes on your Mac.
items.creator: Ivan Mehta
